beats.direction: Use the recurring witness with an on-screen disclaimer: CITY CONTEXT / NOT DAY-SPECIFIC.
beats.voice: Paris exposes the technical production of legitimacy through calendar inclusion, monumental rooms, official images, digital programmes, showrooms and archives. This chapter follows capture: The collection walks once; cameras, edits, metadata and rights agreements decide which view can be repeated and who can repeat it.
beats.onScreen: Then: FHCM collection pages bind houses and seasons to official digital records, with visible platform or production credits on some pages.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: FHCM collection pages bind houses and seasons to official digital records, with visible platform or production credits on some pages. That earlier record fixes a point in time; it does not prove an inevitable progression toward the present.
beats.onScreen: Now: An official page can preserve film, lookbook and credit context while leaving underlying image, music and performer rights layered and separate.

beats.direction: Animate only line reveals and state changes in the original evidence diagram.
beats.voice: The distinction is material. A polished interface can survive after its workers, contracts, specifications or permission trail disappear, leaving the audience with an outcome but not its operating history.
